unlisted_practices: Two-pass LLM workflow in which a first pass screens notes for adverse drug events and a second pass extracts structured fields
Expert consensus adjudication of LLM-identified events missing from the gold standard
Automated MedDRA coding of extracted adverse drug events

screen.reason: Evaluates an OpenAI o1 LLM pipeline for extracting adverse drug event signals from retrospective de-identified EHR notes, focusing on model accuracy and extraction performance rather than testing a deployment guardrail.
